digest.component_or_area: completion sidecar and close workflow instrumentation
propositions: Large unattributed timing residuals in close workflow require direct gated-phase instrumentation to attribute multi-minute delays to specific operations

Instrumentation must measure ten millisecond-precision timing phases (pre-verifier, structural, policy, descendant scope, landing, verifier, git history, alias index, ticket ref resolution, diff validation) by threading optional metrics dictionary through existing close call graph without adding I/O, subprocess, network, tracker writes, or model calls

Completion verdict PASS and FAIL outcomes must carry all ten direct timing fields plus existing consumption metrics (commits inspected, distinct references, descendant ids, referencing commits) in sidecar payload
Added instrumentation bookkeeping must cost less than 50 microseconds per close operation as validated by standard-library CPU-time ABBA microbenchmark, with results logged and evidence committed
Duration probe must consume direct timing fields when present and label older records without them as legacy_uninstrumented without inferring causal operation names for their residual intervals
All existing caller behavior must remain unchanged when optional timing dictionary argument is not supplied, with backward compatibility preserved through optional parameters
